entities.summary: Jean Brunhes was a French geographer. His most famous book is La géographie humaine. He was the director of The Archives of the Planet, an international photographic project sponsored by Albert Kahn. He was the father of Mariel Jean-Brunhes Delamarre, his daughter and early research partner.
